segments.sn55.43:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti –
segments.sn55.43:1.4: itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.43:3.1: “Puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammā dukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
segments.sn55.43:3.3: Ime kho, bhikkhave, cattāro puññābhisandā kusalābhisandā sukhassāhārā.
segments.sn55.43:4.1: “Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi puññābhisandehi kusalābhisandehi samannāgatassa ariyasāvakassa na sukaraṃ puññassa pamāṇaṃ gaṇetuṃ –
segments.sn55.43:4.3: Atha kho asaṅkhyeyyo appameyyo mahāpuññakkhandho tveva saṅkhyaṃ gacchatī”ti.

lines: Bhāveti maggaṃ amatassa pattiyāti nibbānassa pāpuṇanatthaṃ arahattamaggaṃ bhāveti.
Dhammasārādhigamoti dhammasāro vuccati ariyaphalaṃ dhammasāro, adhigamo assāti dhammasārādhigamo, adhigataphaloti attho.
“Kusale patiṭṭhito”ti ettha yaṃ accantikaṃ kusale patiṭṭhānaṃ.
Taṃ dassento “maggakusale patiṭṭhito”ti āha, heṭṭhimamaggakusaleti adhippāyo.
Kilesā khīyanti etthāti kilesakkhayo, nibbānaṃ, tasmiṃ kilesakkhaye rato.
